Wyatt Kaiser scores as the Chicago Blackhawks stop a 3-game slide, topping the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 — Wyatt Kaiser snapped a third-period tie, Spencer Knight made 25 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 on Tuesday night.
